reason: The only unguarded dereference in the SET_FIELDS handler was the old sortField ternary, which passed a possibly-undefined firstYAxisNotEquation/firstActionPayloadNotEquation into generateFieldAsString (fields.tsx:1237 reads value.kind) or generateMetricAggregate (reads queryFieldValue.kind); the change replaces the `as QueryFieldValue` casts with explicit truthiness branches so neither function is ever called with undefined, and setSort now runs only inside `if (sortField)`.
